mapper.sql: diff_id, biz_date, type, biz_key, order_id, settlement_id, seller_id, tenant_id, channel_amount, platform_amount, status, resolved_by, resolved_note, resolved_at, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO settlement_recon_diff (biz_date, type, biz_key, order_id, settlement_id, seller_id, tenant_id, channel_amount, platform_amount, status, create_time) VALUES (#{bizDate}, #{type}, #{bizKey}, #{orderId}, #{settlementId}, #{sellerId}, #{tenantId}, #{channelAmount}, #{platformAmount}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_recon_diff SET status = 'resolved', resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_note = #{resolvedNote}, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE diff_id = #{diffId} AND status = 'open' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_recon_diff WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'open'
mapper.update: UPDATE seller_account a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, tenant_id FROM settlement_recon_diff WHERE biz_date = #{bizDate} AND status = 'open') d ON d.seller_id = a.seller_id AND d.tenant_id = a.tenant_id SET a.frozen = 1, a.update_time = NOW() WHERE a.frozen = 0
